note: Route collector: cfg-disjoint twin mod declarations (#[cfg(unix)] mod m; beside #[cfg(not(unix))] mod m;) mount their routes under any(all(..), all(..)) instead of an always-false AND; an ungated #[path] module loads only its target in every build, so a test-only child of it stays out of the OpenAPI document; #[path] children are resolved as rustc resolves them (beside a non-mod.rs target); ungated mod and #[path] declarations of every declaring file count, not only files with cfg and test text, and a declaration counts only when its declaring file is itself loaded in every build.
